mapper.insert: INSERT INTO appr_decision_outbox ( event_id, event_type, tenant_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_version, schema_version, occurred_at, trace_id, producer, payload_json, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{message.messageId}, #{message.eventType}, CAST(#{message.tenantId} AS BIGINT), #{message.aggregateType}, #{message.aggregateId}, #{message.version}, #{message.schemaVersion}, #{message.occurredAt}, #{message.traceId}, #{message.producer}, CAST(#{message.payloadJson} AS JSONB), 'PENDING', 0, NOW(), NOW(), NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WITH candidates AS ( SELECT outbox.id FROM appr_decision_outbox outbox WHERE outbox.next_attempt_at <= #{now} AND ( outbox.status = 'PENDING' OR (outbox.status = 'IN_FLIGHT' AND outbox.lease_until <= #{now}) ) ORDER BY outbox.next_attempt_at, outbox.created_at, outbox.id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT #{limit} ) UPDATE appr_decision_outbox outbox SET status = 'IN_FLIGHT', lease_owner = #{workerId}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, attempts = outbox.attempts + 1, updated_at = #{now} FROM candidates WHERE outbox.id = candidates.id RETURNING outbox.id, outbox.event_id, outbox.event_type, outbox.tenant_id, outbox.aggregate_type, outbox.aggregate_id, outbox.event_version, outbox.schema_version, outbox.occurred_at, outbox.trace_id, outbox.producer, outbox.payload_json::text AS payload_json, outbox.attempts
